name: Learned Initializations for Neural Fields
aliases: Learned Initializations for Optimizing Coordinate-Based Neural Representations
definition: A technique to address the inefficiency of optimizing a coordinate-based network from randomly initialized weights for each new signal by applying standard meta-learning algorithms to learn the initial weight parameters based on the underlying class of signals.
summary: Learned Initializations uses meta-learning to derive optimal starting weights for neural fields, enabling faster convergence and better generalization than random initialization by decoupling initialization from instance-specific optimization.
